name: Folding Fan
description: Open paper hand fans tossed at angles, each leaf folded into ten pleats with every other one in shadow, the wooden guard showing below.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--fan); clip-path: @var(--fan); -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-2, 14)%) rotate(@r(-30, 30)deg) scale(@r(1.05, 1.3)); transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-2, 14)%) rotate(@r(-30, 30)deg) scale(@r(1.05, 1.3)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--leaf); clip-path: @var(--leaf); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); opacity: 0.3; -webkit-clip-path: @var(--leaf); clip-path: @var(--leaf); -webkit-mask: @var(--pleats); mask: @var(--pleats); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
